lessons_used: Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning across 2 tests.
Finish hint changes have shown no clear effect across 4 tests.
Adoption redesign changes have shown no clear effect or performed worse across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption layout, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, home redesign, home wait_info, sign_in copy, sign_in redesign, and sign_in reorder changes as only one test has been completed for each.

candidates.title: Desktop controls interactive quick guide redesign
candidates.change: Replaces the default welcome component on the final intro screen with an interactive desktop control showcase component showing how to move, hide, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Support emails show 3 complaints about confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.

home_welcome.label: Interactive pet controls preview
home_welcome.text: Click pet to chat, right-click tray icon to manage or hide

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: New pet interaction tutorial screen before finish
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen 'new_controls_guide' right before home_intro that introduces basic desktop pet commands and tray shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 for controls, 4 for desktop misbehavior) report post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_controls_guide']

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in after photo upload step
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step to take place immediately after photo upload/customization and right before the adoption certificate creation.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% drop-off; placing sign-in right after pet customization increases user commitment and account creation rates.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step within onboarding, which is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Leverages user investment to improve adoption step drop-off, backed by +3.1% in one prior test.

candidates.title: Interactive waiting room mini game sub-flow
candidates.change: Introduces a pet care sub-flow on the waiting screen featuring play and feed mini-actions while rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen takes median 201s (mean 2336s). Lessons show new home sub-flows have won 2 previous tests.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive waiting sub-flow while preserving the waiting screen's job.

candidates.score_note: Strong confidence from 2 winning tests in home new_flow, targeting a 2336s mean wait time.

candidates.title: Account sync warning copy on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Updates the sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in links pets to the account to prevent data loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, making account sync clarity crucial.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Log in with your existing account to ensure your custom pet and accessories are backed up safely.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to explain account linking without dark patterns or pricing references.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from 8 support emails, but sign_in copy previously lost 4.3%.

candidates.title: Estimated rendering timer component on waiting screen
candidates.change: Adds a dynamic timer component and countdown estimate display to the pet generation waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off due to uncertain wait times.

guard.reason: Adds an estimated timer display during a real wait time, which is allowed under rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses long wait duration with a modest +1.0% initial test result.

candidates.title: Account restore hint for existing users on sign-in
candidates.change: Adds a hint box below sign-in options reassuring returning users that signing in restores their previous desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Already have a pet? Sign in with your primary account to automatically restore your pet.

guard.reason: Adds helpful sign-in hint text for existing users without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email alignment, but hints have shown no clear impact across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate official seal badge incentive
candidates.change: Adds an official adoption seal badge and congratulatory reward text to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with a median time of 89s; adding ownership reinforcement improves completion.

guard.reason: Adds a badge to the adoption certificate without violating pricing or job requirements.

candidates.score_note: Targets the largest drop-off step (adoption at 60.9%) using visual ownership incentive.

candidates.title: Waiting completion notification toggle
candidates.change: Enables notification options and adds a readiness notify toggle switch on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait stage takes a mean of 2336s; letting users opt into desktop notifications allows them to safely minimize the app.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet finish rendering.

guard.reason: Adds a desktop notification option during the pet rendering wait step.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the 2336s mean home wait time by encouraging multi-tasking via notifications.

candidates.title: Two column path selection screen layout
candidates.change: Changes the choose_path screen layout to two_column for side-by-side comparison of instant pick vs custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of users; side-by-side layout aids quicker decision making.

guard.reason: Changes choose_path layout to two columns while preserving both path options.

candidates.score_note: Reduces high mean duration (514s) on choose_path through side-by-side comparison.
